title: feat(scripts): codemod-split-protocol --members moves the bodies E1 refuses, unedited, and retires nineteen protocol.ts facade rows
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-elon-musk"} -->
_Requested by **Elon** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9D?thread=cmsg_01WedDzV26nniwxv7jC88B9DKNzscdiyWjPUtwr9RQB2g1)_

Part of #30147

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members` 新增三种不改写方法体的搬移形式(`.call(host)` 接收者、statics 转发器、无接收者的 plain 形式)外加静态表搬到叶子模块,并用它把 protocol.ts 上 19 个还留着方法体的成员搬进各自的 facet。
- 为什么改:这 19 个成员是 facade 门禁登记里引用 #30147 的例外行;E1 改写(`this.x` → `host.x`)搬不了它们,只能当例外留在类上。
- 风险与回滚:纯搬移,方法体逐字节不变(撤销证明重建 base 树);公开 `index.d.ts` 的表面不变,只有 14 个 private 成员的 docblock 随方法体搬走;回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` 顶部新增的 `ObjectStackProtocolImplementationStatics` 与类尾的 static block;`scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs` 的 receiver forms 一节;`scripts/check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` 的 stub 解析。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members --verify --base 616311c126`,预期输出 `forms: e1 2, plain 5, statics 5, receiver 3, table 4` 与 `undoing the moves does rebuild … byte-for-byte`,退出码 0。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地。

## What changes

**The tool.** The members pass (#30518) moved a member only when E1's
rewrite could carry it, so it refused a local named `host`, a body that
reads no member, and every private static that reads the class. It now
ports the two mechanisms the sql-driver codemod grew (#30249, #30306), for
those reasons only (`RECEIVER_SOLVES`), and moves the body unedited:

- **receiver**: the facet member's `this` is typed as the `Pick` of `ProtocolHost`
  it reads, and the stub runs it on the host: `return FACET.x.call(protocolHost(this), …)`.
- **statics**: `ObjectStackProtocolImplementationStatics`, declared ahead of
  the class and filled by a static block at its end, forwards each static a
  moved body reads. A facet module imports it AS the class name, so a body
  that names the class reads it unedited; a private static that reads
  `this` runs on it: `FACET.x.call(ObjectStackProtocolImplementationStatics, …)`.
- **plain**: a body that reads nothing of the class: `return FACET.x(…)`.
- **table**: a private static readonly field's initializer moves to its
  section's leaf, `protocol-write-gates-tables.ts`, which imports no
  relative module (an initializer runs while the class is evaluated).
- A predicate a moved body reaches through the host gets a host entry typed
  as the predicate, so the narrowing survives the hop.

The undo proof covers every form: from the head alone each stub, facet
member, forwarder entry, host entry and leaf is undone and the result is
the base tree byte for byte.

**The moves.** Nineteen members, all in sections that already have a facet:
`reconcileViewExpansions`, `packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal`,
`namedBaseOverlayWriteRefusal`, `mergesOverlayAtRead`,
`registryAllowsOverlay`, `isOverlayAllowed`, `isRuntimeCreateAllowed`,
`codeOnlySourceHint`, `codeOnlyCreateError`, `codeOnlyOverrideError`,
`refuseOrganizationScopedWrite`, `overlayPackageMismatchError`,
`rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned`, `objectExtensionItemRefusal`,
`packagedBaseRefusal` and the four tables `OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES`,
`STATIC_REGISTRY_TYPES`, `RUNTIME_CREATE_ALLOWED_TYPES`,
`OVERLAY_CAPABLE_TYPES`. Forms: e1 2, plain 5, statics 5, receiver 3,
table 4. `protocol.ts` goes from 13,007 to 12,577 lines.

**The registry.** The nineteen rows are deleted (46 to 27 exceptions).
`triggerAutomation` stays, its reason rewritten as an accepted exception:
its body is one `throw`, and its section has no facet module, which this
pass never starts. `getDiscovery` (a hand move) and the engine.ts and
sql-driver.ts rows are the later PRs of this card.

**Followers of the moved bodies.**

- `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs` resolved a stub only in the
  E1 and facade-host shapes, so three read seams whose catch delegates to
  the moved `rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned` read as inventing an
  answer. Its resolver now follows the receiver, statics and plain stubs to
  the facet member, and a facet member's `this.x()` through the imported
  host or forwarder interface. Its output on this tree is byte-identical to
  the base's.
- Three source-reading pins in `packages/metadata-protocol` follow the moved
  bodies: the bracketed-opener scan's producer floors, the `registerItem(`
  call site's file, and the view-expansion record's forwarder read.
- One platform-checklist citation (`protocol.ts#refusal`) points at
  `protocol-write-gates.ts`.

## Why

Ruling 6624345766 item 3 wants every facade-gate exception row to name the
card that moves it, and #30147 phase 3 measured that one codemod port would
retire about 19 of its 21 protocol.ts rows (comment 6653253380). The rows
that stay are named in this card's report.

## Tests

- `node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --self-test`: 112 cases in 13
  batteries pass (85 in 10 before). The three new batteries generate each
  form on a fixture, fail ten mutations of the proof, and refuse seven
  inputs no form carries.
- `check-durability-degradation-log-level.mjs --self-test`: 86 read-seam
  cases pass (81 before). Ablation: the five new cases against the base
  resolver fail the three positive ones; the two negative controls pass on
  both.
- `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` vitest: base `4d56914aaa` 320 files
  passed, 4 skipped; 22,487 tests passed, 26 skipped. Head `ae519e3e99`: 320
  files and 22,489 tests pass, 26 skipped (the two new producer rows of the
  bracketed-opener pin are the +2; one file first read a `spec` dist built
  before the rebase onto `616311c126` and passes, 18/18, once rebuilt).
- `packages/rest` vitest at `7d49cfc21` (this branch before its rebase onto four unrelated `main` commits): 398 files, 7,752 tests passed, 354
  skipped. At base the local worktree loaded 383 of 398 files (15 import a
  sibling package's `src` that the worktree had no `node_modules` for), all
  of them passing. `discovery-search-capability-agreement.test.ts` 4/4 at base and
  head.

## Acceptance notes

- **The `.d.ts` bar.** The public surface of `dist/index.d.ts` and
  `dist/index.d.cts` is equal. The files are not byte-equal: 14 private
  members' docblocks changed, because a private member's docblock moves with
  its body (docblock ownership, as in #29985). Stripped of docblocks the two
  sides are identical (sha256 `5cf3216a10daa533…` base, `9cab7eb90040d456…`
  head).
- **The one difference a body could see.** A static reached through the
  forwarder runs with the class as `this`, never a subclass; every static
  it forwards is private, so no subclass reaches one.
- **Doc hover.** `{@link ObjectStackProtocolImplementation.x}` in a facet
  module that imports the forwarder now resolves to the forwarder.
- No open pull request touches `packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol*.ts`
  (checked against all open pulls at the time of writing).

## Verification

<details><summary>Undo proof</summary>

`node scripts/codemod-split-protocol.mjs --members --verify --base 616311c126` at `ae519e3e99`: exit 0.

```text
undo proof (#30518, #30147): 19 moved member(s) (objectExtensionItemRefusal, rethrowUnlessMetadataStoreUnprovisioned, mergesOverlayAtRead, registryAllowsOverlay, isOverlayAllowed, isRuntimeCreateAllowed, codeOnlySourceHint, codeOnlyCreateError, codeOnlyOverrideError, refuseOrganizationScopedWrite, packagedBaseRefusal, packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal, namedBaseOverlayWriteRefusal, overlayPackageMismatchError, reconcileViewExpansions, OVERLAY_ALLOWED_TYPES, STATIC_REGISTRY_TYPES, RUNTIME_CREATE_ALLOWED_TYPES, OVERLAY_CAPABLE_TYPES); forms: e1 2, plain 5, statics 5, receiver 3, table 4; host-split check: 2/2 E1 move(s) pass (the receiver forms move bodies unedited, proved byte-equal); protocol.ts 13007 -> 12577 lines; undoing the moves does rebuild the base protocol.ts, protocol-host.ts and section modules byte-for-byte once the 9 import binding(s) only moved bodies read are pruned from the base (OBJECT_EXTENSION_TYPE, ObjectExtensionRegistry, SINGULAR_TO_PLURAL, metadataReadFailureError, namedBaseCloseSubject, objectExtensionItemRefusal, packagedBaseRegimeRow, packagelessCloseSubject, packagelessOverlayWriteRefusal)
```
</details>

<details><summary>Facade gate and companions</summary>

`node scripts/check-facade-delegation-only.mjs`: exit 0, 27 named
exceptions. `pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol typecheck` exit 0,
`build` exit 0. `pnpm check:platform-checklist` exit 0.
`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:liveness` exit 0. eslint on the
changed files: clean.
</details>

<details><summary>dispatch-gates</summary>

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `ae519e3e99`: 86 families derived, all 86 run, all exit 0 (codes captured before any pipe). `--ran`: 86 derived, 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. Four gates first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET or red on a partial build or a shallow clone (`check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`) or before the durability resolver fix (`check:durability-log-level`); each exit 0 on the re-run after a full `pnpm build`.
</details>

<details><summary>Changed lines</summary>

2,459 changed lines (+1,720 / −739, 15 files, changeset included), under the 3,000 budget.
</details>

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic.
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes.
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
